job_spec.purpose: el1011-ds-misc/pqc structural redesign of ot_v41_pqc_spine_screen (audit class 1: one clock tree over 133k/225k sinks, CTS hold stuck -65 ps, all pqc jobs cancelled): the v15 spine (physical/s81_pq_hier, same ports and cycle timing) is wiring over hardened tiles with own clock trees, reset relays, register-to-register seams. This job routes sub-tile pqc_xin_a: physical/s81_pq_hier).  T_XIN: the screen x_q pin registers (1,024 b, no reset) so the composition top holds no soft flops; d on the N face, q on the S face. Variant a: 115.2 x 17.28 um.  Own clock tree and reset relay; datapath unreset; seams register to register.

rtl_boundary.waive: el1011-ds-misc/pqc v15 tile: the cut follows existing spine registers; tile inputs land in registers (T_IX ba_v/ba_blk pass a 3-bit block decode into the enable copies; T_CTL is the spine control with its original screen-registered inputs; the ROM stand-ins are the unchanged screen fixture with a combinational word select after registers).
